key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr avenger](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr Avenger](Disk 1 of 2).adf:type:0:0136
name: copy_sixteen_longs_then_jump
description: Copies sixteen 32-bit values from a fixed offset in a structure into a caller-supplied buffer when that buffer pointer is non-null, then jumps through a stored code pointer. It is reached from find_max_and_prepare_buffer.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr avenger](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr Avenger](Disk 1 of 2).adf:setpatch:0:0000
name: setup_setpatch_entry_point
description: Program entry of the SetPatch executable: it opens the dos and exec libraries, checks the current directory, allocates memory and waits on a message port. On failure it raises an alert; the referenced text names NIL: and dos.library.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr avenger](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr Avenger](Disk 1 of 2).adf:setpatch:0:01A0
name: swap_and_release_task_slot
description: Stores a new value into a per-task slot and, if the previous value's fields are set, closes the file and library it held, frees memory and replies to a message. It also calls the task-lookup and forbid library functions.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr avenger](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr Avenger](Disk 1 of 2).adf:setpatch:3:0000
name: dispatch_twice_if_flag_set
description: Calls a dispatch routine, then calls it again with the parameter only when a global flag is non-zero, and finally calls the dispatch routine once more. It uses the library stubs call_dispatch and call_library_vector_132.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr avenger](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr Avenger](Disk 1 of 2).adf:setpatch:3:0030
name: apply_optional_library_patches
description: Parses the command-line arguments and applies a set of library patches, printing a status line for each: Alert, AllocEntry, DOS Execute, Layers and the 68881/68882 exception handlers. It reports an error when layers.library cannot be opened.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr avenger](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr Avenger](Disk 1 of 2).adf:setpatch:15:0004
name: call_indirect_and_return_d1
description: Calls a routine whose address is read from a global pointer at a fixed offset and returns the value left in data register D1.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr avenger](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr Avenger](Disk 1 of 2).adf:setpatch:8:0000
name: allocate_memory_under_conditions
description: Checks size and flag fields of a global structure and, when they qualify, uses TypeOfMem with AllocMem or AllocAbs under Forbid and Permit to obtain a memory block, then calls a library function with the block.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr avenger](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr Avenger](Disk 1 of 2).adf:setpatch:8:00B4
name: compute_complemented_word_checksum
description: Sums a block of 16-bit words starting at a fixed offset in a structure, stores the one's complement of the sum in a following field, and then transfers control through a jump table.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr avenger](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr Avenger](Disk 1 of 2).adf:setpatch:13:0000
name: install_disk_resource_hook
description: Opens disk.resource and, when a size field is small, sets a global flag, installs replacement functions through SetFunction and adjusts a global counter. The referenced text names disk.resource and the facts list the interrupt-enable register.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr avenger](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr Avenger](Disk 1 of 2).adf:setpatch:13:007C
name: copy_word_on_successful_call
description: Calls a stored routine pointer and, if it returns non-zero, copies a 32-bit field from a fixed offset in a system structure into a global variable.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr avenger](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr Avenger](Disk 1 of 2).adf:setpatch:13:0094
name: dispatch_when_status_matches
description: Returns at once unless a stored status word equals the expected value or is minus one; otherwise it calls through a stored routine pointer.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr avenger](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr Avenger](Disk 1 of 2).adf:setpatch:13:00A8
name: call_handler_on_minus_one
description: If the input value in D1 is minus one, it calls a stored routine pointer; for any other value it returns without action.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr avenger](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr Avenger](Disk 1 of 2).adf:setpatch:5:0000
name: stamp_marker_and_dispatch
description: Sets a global to a fixed value and, if a marker at the bottom of memory does not match a constant, writes the marker and two words there. It then calls through a pointer in a global structure when a flag bit is clear.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr avenger](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr Avenger](Disk 1 of 2).adf:setpatch:5:0042
name: call_global_slot_routine
description: Calls a routine whose address is read from a global structure at a fixed offset, with no arguments.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr avenger](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr Avenger](Disk 1 of 2).adf:setpatch:9:0000
name: fill_routine_address_table
description: Stores a computed offset in a global variable and fills a sixteen-entry table with successive addresses of this routine, each two bytes apart.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr avenger](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr Avenger](Disk 1 of 2).adf:setpatch:9:0038
name: call_routine_repeatedly_return_last
description: Calls the same routine several times in sequence and returns the value produced by the final call.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr avenger](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr Avenger](Disk 1 of 2).adf:setpatch:9:003C
name: call_routine_repeatedly_return_last
description: Calls the same routine several times in sequence and returns the value produced by the final call.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr avenger](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr Avenger](Disk 1 of 2).adf:setpatch:9:003E
name: call_routine_repeatedly_return_last
description: Calls the same routine several times in sequence and returns the value produced by the final call.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr avenger](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr Avenger](Disk 1 of 2).adf:setpatch:9:005E
name: return_input_value
description: Returns the value received in the data register unchanged, with no other operation.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr avenger](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr Avenger](Disk 1 of 2).adf:setpatch:7:0000
name: install_function_if_index_low
description: If a 16-bit field in a global structure does not exceed a fixed limit, it calls a library function through a pointer stored in a global, which installs a function with exec SetFunction.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr avenger](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr Avenger](Disk 1 of 2).adf:setpatch:7:001E
name: copy_entry_fields_into_block
description: Reads a 16-bit size field from a structure and calls a library function to obtain a block; if that returns a non-zero pointer, it stores the size there and copies the following fields across in a loop before returning a status value.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr avenger](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr Avenger](Disk 1 of 2).adf:setpatch:7:0080
name: call_library_loop_return_flagged
description: Calls a library routine once for each step of a 16-bit counter until it goes negative, then returns the 32-bit word at a pointer with its top bit set.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr avenger](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr Avenger](Disk 1 of 2).adf:setpatch:7:0094
name: call_library_return_flagged_word
description: Calls a library routine once and then returns the 32-bit word at a pointer with its top bit set.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr avenger](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr Avenger](Disk 1 of 2).adf:setpatch:6:0010
name: stub_empty_return_routine
description: Empty routine that only returns; it does nothing and is referenced only by address from call_library_vector_30.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr avenger](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr Avenger](Disk 1 of 2).adf:setpatch:12:0000
name: invoke_pair_if_check_passes
description: Calls a stored check routine with a field from a structure and, if the check succeeds, calls two further stored routines, passing the field to the last one. It returns whether the check succeeded.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr avenger](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr Avenger](Disk 1 of 2).adf:setpatch:10:0000
name: find_bsr_instruction_word
description: Walks forward through 68000 instruction words and returns the first word whose top byte is the BSR branch opcode.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr avenger](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr Avenger](Disk 1 of 2).adf:setpatch:10:001E
name: compute_branch_target_address
description: Computes the target address of a 68000 branch instruction, sign-extending either the 8-bit displacement in the opcode or the following 16-bit displacement word.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr avenger](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr Avenger](Disk 1 of 2).adf:setpatch:10:0050
name: compute_word_displacement_target
description: Reads the signed 16-bit displacement word after a branch opcode and returns the address it reaches, relative to that word.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr avenger](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr Avenger](Disk 1 of 2).adf:setpatch:10:0076
name: store_three_decoded_addresses
description: Steps through a run of instruction words using the branch-target routines and stores three resulting addresses in global variables.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr avenger](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr Avenger](Disk 1 of 2).adf:setpatch:17:0000
name: forward_with_stack_pointer
description: Passes its two parameters on to another routine together with the address of a stack slot.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr avenger](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr Avenger](Disk 1 of 2).adf:setpatch:16:0000
name: format_and_output_message
description: Formats a message through exec RawDoFmt into a 140-byte local buffer, measures the resulting string length and passes the text on to an output routine.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr avenger](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr Avenger](Disk 1 of 2).adf:endcli:0:0000
name: run_endcli_entry_max_scan
description: Program entry of the EndCli executable. It walks a linked list to find the largest stored value, uses a 140-byte stack buffer and calls find_max_and_prepare_buffer and one further routine to write the results.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr avenger](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr Avenger](Disk 1 of 2).adf:endcli:0:0136
name: copy_sixteen_longs_then_jump
description: Copies sixteen 32-bit values from a fixed offset in a structure into a caller-supplied buffer when that buffer pointer is non-null, then jumps through a stored code pointer. It is reached from find_max_and_prepare_buffer.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr avenger](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr Avenger](Disk 1 of 2).adf:delphine:0:0000
name: clear_startup_memory_block
description: Zeroes a large block of memory by writing zero longwords in a loop, then stores the register value passed at entry and calls a library routine.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr avenger](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr Avenger](Disk 1 of 2).adf:delphine:0:0006
name: mask_byte_on_flag_condition
description: When the carry flag is set and the overflow and negative flags differ, it returns the input byte ORed with a fixed mask; otherwise it stores a fixed value in a global and returns the byte unchanged.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr avenger](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr Avenger](Disk 1 of 2).adf:delphine:0:0016
name: set_global_status_bit
description: Sets bit one of a global status byte and returns. Its facts list the CIA-A port register as touched, which carries fire-button and disk status.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr avenger](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr Avenger](Disk 1 of 2).adf:delphine:0:0020
name: read_button_status_bits
description: Builds a small result from the inverted state of bit six and bit two of a global status byte and returns it. The facts list the CIA-A port and the potentiometer input as touched, which carry the fire and right/middle buttons.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr avenger](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr Avenger](Disk 1 of 2).adf:delphine:0:0074
name: store_fixed_status_value
description: Stores a fixed status value in a global variable and returns; its facts list the interrupt-enable register as touched.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr avenger](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr Avenger](Disk 1 of 2).adf:delphine:0:007E
name: store_fixed_flag_word
description: Stores a fixed value with its top bit set in a global variable and returns; its facts list the interrupt-enable register as touched.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr avenger](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr Avenger](Disk 1 of 2).adf:delphine:0:0088
name: set_global_bit_three
description: Sets a global variable to the value with only bit three set and returns; its facts list the interrupt-enable register as touched.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr avenger](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr Avenger](Disk 1 of 2).adf:delphine:0:009C
name: next_pseudorandom_scaled_value
description: Advances a stored pseudo-random state by shifting it and XOR-ing with a fixed feedback constant when the carry is set, then returns the state divided by the 16-bit argument.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr avenger](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr Avenger](Disk 1 of 2).adf:delphine:0:00C8
name: acknowledge_keyboard_serial_byte
description: When a request bit is set in a global status byte, it decodes the pending keyboard byte by inverting and rotating it, waits in a short delay loop and clears the request bit. Its facts list the CIA-A serial data and control registers as touched.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr avenger](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr Avenger](Disk 1 of 2).adf:delphine:0:00FA
name: lookup_keycode_in_table
description: Searches a table of 49 raw key codes for the input code and returns the companion value stored for the first match; codes with the top bit set or zero are handled separately.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr avenger](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr Avenger](Disk 1 of 2).adf:delphine:0:0166
name: copy_word_table_into_buffer
description: Copies 180 16-bit words from a fixed table into a buffer reached through a global pointer, then stores a masked parameter into a header word and writes further fields from the second argument.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr avenger](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr Avenger](Disk 1 of 2).adf:delphine:0:0314
name: write_fixed_word_values
description: Writes a fixed sequence of 16-bit constants into offsets of a structure reached through a global pointer.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr avenger](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr Avenger](Disk 1 of 2).adf:delphine:0:0396
name: configure_slot_fields
description: Writes a fixed value, a 32-bit parameter and a zero word into fields of a structure reached through a global pointer, then writes a second fixed value to a control word.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr avenger](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr Avenger](Disk 1 of 2).adf:delphine:0:03C4
name: read_stored_long_value
description: Returns the 32-bit value stored at a fixed offset in a global table and is called from three routines.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr avenger](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr Avenger](Disk 1 of 2).adf:delphine:0:03D0
name: store_split_address_fields
description: Stores its first argument in a global unless it is minus one. When the second argument is valid it waits for a raster line and writes the high and low halves of that value, and a second value offset by a fixed amount, into a list structure.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr avenger](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr Avenger](Disk 1 of 2).adf:delphine:0:04E4
name: copy_sixteen_words_into_structure
description: Copies sixteen 16-bit words from an input array into alternate word slots of a structure reached through a global pointer.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr avenger](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr Avenger](Disk 1 of 2).adf:delphine:0:0522
name: store_arguments_then_wait_blitter
description: Stores its eleven arguments into fields of a structure reached through a global pointer, then waits until the blitter has finished.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr avenger](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr Avenger](Disk 1 of 2).adf:delphine:0:05E4
name: stub_empty_return_routine
description: Empty routine that only returns; it does nothing.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr avenger](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr Avenger](Disk 1 of 2).adf:delphine:0:05EC
name: call_setup_with_sentinel_args
description: Computes a pointer from a global base and calls a routine with it, then calls another routine with two all-ones 16-bit arguments and finally a routine with no arguments.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr avenger](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr Avenger](Disk 1 of 2).adf:delphine:0:06A2
name: read_dos_lock_info_value
description: Locks a fixed DOS name, reads a 32-bit field from the information block returned by DOS Info, then unlocks it and returns that value, or zero if the lock fails. Its facts list the Info and lock wrappers.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr avenger](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr Avenger](Disk 1 of 2).adf:delphine:0:06F2
name: read_dh0_volume_field
description: Locks the volume named DH0: through DOS, reads a 16-bit field from its information block and unlocks it, returning the value or zero if the lock cannot be obtained.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr avenger](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr Avenger](Disk 1 of 2).adf:delphine:0:0750
name: negate_then_call_routines
description: The decompiler timed out, so only the listed facts are known: the routine has 43 instructions, negates a register, makes four calls to other routines and is called from three places.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr avenger](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr Avenger](Disk 1 of 2).adf:delphine:0:07E4
name: forward_to_single_routine
description: The decompiler timed out, so only the listed facts are known: a 22-instruction routine that makes a single call to another routine and is called from ten places.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr avenger](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr Avenger](Disk 1 of 2).adf:delphine:0:0832
name: setup_display_and_load_data
description: Sets up display-related structures over many steps, waits for raster lines and stores several fields. It references the file names AUTO00.PRC and texte.dat.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr avenger](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr Avenger](Disk 1 of 2).adf:delphine:0:0DC8
name: stub_empty_return_routine
description: Empty routine that only returns; it does nothing.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr avenger](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr Avenger](Disk 1 of 2).adf:delphine:0:0DD0
name: swap_two_stored_pointers
description: Exchanges two 32-bit values held in globals, passes the low halves of the swapped values to another routine and calls a raster-line wait routine.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr avenger](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr Avenger](Disk 1 of 2).adf:delphine:0:0E38
name: wait_raster_then_set_word
description: Waits for a raster line to pass, then stores a fixed 16-bit word in a field of a structure reached through a global pointer.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr avenger](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr Avenger](Disk 1 of 2).adf:delphine:0:0E4E
name: process_and_clear_record_table
description: Walks a table of fixed-size records and, for each non-zero entry, calls a routine with the stored value and a product of two 16-bit fields, then clears the entry.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr avenger](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr Avenger](Disk 1 of 2).adf:delphine:0:0EE0
name: allocate_free_table_slot
description: Scans a table of up to 255 fixed-size records for an empty slot. If none is free it returns minus one; otherwise it calls another routine with a product of two parameters and records the result in that slot.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr avenger](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr Avenger](Disk 1 of 2).adf:delphine:0:0FC0
name: call_routine_for_table_slot
description: Looks up a record in a fixed-size table by index; if the record is empty it returns minus one, otherwise it calls another routine with two stored fields multiplied together.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr avenger](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr Avenger](Disk 1 of 2).adf:delphine:0:10BE
name: repeat_routine_by_count
description: Calls a routine once for each step of a 16-bit counter passed in as the argument.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr avenger](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr Avenger](Disk 1 of 2).adf:delphine:0:10E4
name: clear_two_list_heads
description: Sets two 32-bit list head pointers in a global structure to null.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr avenger](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr Avenger](Disk 1 of 2).adf:delphine:0:10F4
name: walk_list_calling_routine
description: Walks a singly linked list from a global head, passing each node with a fixed size argument to another routine, then calls a finishing routine.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr avenger](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr Avenger](Disk 1 of 2).adf:delphine:0:112A
name: insert_node_in_sorted_list
description: Walks a linked list ordered by a 16-bit key and links the given node in at the position where its key fits.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr avenger](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr Avenger](Disk 1 of 2).adf:delphine:0:11EC
name: find_node_by_word_pair
description: Walks the linked list from a global head and returns the first node whose two stored 16-bit fields match the two halves of the argument.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr avenger](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr Avenger](Disk 1 of 2).adf:delphine:0:12A6
name: clear_list_head_pair
description: Sets two 32-bit pointers in a second global list structure to null.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr avenger](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr Avenger](Disk 1 of 2).adf:delphine:0:12B6
name: walk_list_calling_routine
description: Walks a singly linked list from a global head, passing each node with a fixed size argument to another routine, then calls a finishing routine.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr avenger](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr Avenger](Disk 1 of 2).adf:delphine:0:12EC
name: append_new_node_to_list
description: Walks to the tail of a list kept in a global head, obtains a new fixed-size node from another routine and links it at the tail.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr avenger](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr Avenger](Disk 1 of 2).adf:delphine:0:131C
name: create_and_link_node
description: Obtains a new fixed-size node from another routine, links it into the list structures referenced by stack-based pointers and sets a 16-bit field in it.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr avenger](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr Avenger](Disk 1 of 2).adf:delphine:0:13DA
